entities.name: Wild Hunt
entities.description: A midwinter hunt celebrated of old by the denizens of the Wilds of Eldraine, ending in a blood sacrifice.

entities.name: Wilds of Eldraine
entities.description: Region of Eldraine where the Wild Hunt is celebrated by elves.

entities.name: Realm
entities.description: The human lands of Eldraine, where the Wild Hunt is outlawed.

entities.name: Elves
entities.description: Denizens of the Wilds who ride in the Wild Hunt; the meal binds their clans.

events.summary: Each midwinter the elves of the Wilds ride the Wild Hunt for three days around the solstice.
events.quote: The celebrations of the Wild Hunt last three days around the winter solstice.

events.summary: The hunt kills its prey at dawn and ends with a blood sacrifice to fend off death.
events.quote: The midwinter hunt rides all night and kills its prey at dawn.
